response.sql: WITH race_name_averages AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId WHERE ds.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points) AS overall_avg FROM race_name_averages) SELECT race_name, avg_points, avg_points - overall_avg AS difference FROM race_name_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE avg_points > overall_avg
